name: FPS
description: Maximum frame rate.

name: Latency
description: End-to-end delay.

name: Resolution
description: Maximum supported resolution.

name: Dynamic Bandwidth Tuning
description: Automatically adjusts video quality and bitrate on the fly to match the user's current internet bandwidth.

name: Video Stream Protocol
description: Choice of transmission protocol (WebRTC for minimal latency vs. H.264/MJPEG for compatibility).

name: USB HID Emulation
description: Software emulation of a keyboard and mouse (including absolute/relative positioning).

name: Mouse Modes (Absolute / Relative)
description: Switches between mouse modes (absolute — for browser/BIOS use, relative — for games and 3D applications).

name: Audio Streaming
description: Captures and streams audio from the target machine.

name: Microphone
description: Passes through the client's microphone.

name: Gamepad Support
description: Supports passthrough of gamepads and game controllers.

name: Power Control
description: Remote power on, power off, and hard-reset functionality for the PC.

name: Virtual Media Emulation
description: Mounts virtual ISO, CD/DVD, and flash drive images for remote OS installation.

name: Physical HDD Emulation & RAM Cache
description: Emulates a full physical drive (HDD/SSD) with LPDDR4X caching of the network stream.

name: Read-Write Overlay (Non-Destructive Mode)
description: A safe overlay mode: session writes go to a separate layer, keeping the original image untouched.

name: GPIO Control via Web UI
description: Controls GPIO pins (relays, smart outlets, lights) directly from the web interface.

name: Multiport KVM Support
description: Software support for chaining and switching between multiple hosts.

name: PoE Support
description: Power over Ethernet.

name: Wake-on-LAN (WoL) Sender
description: Sends Magic Packets directly from the KVM UI to wake devices on the local network.

name: Wi-Fi
description: Wireless network support.

name: Ethernet (LAN)
description: Wired local network connection via RJ-45 cable.

name: Virtual Network Adapter
description: Emulates a virtual network card to share internet/network access with the target host.

name: Zero-Config Remote Access
description: Built-in VPN tunnel support (Tailscale / ZeroTier) for accessing the KVM without a public IP.

name: Clientless Browser
description: Desktop access without installing third-party clients, Java, or plugins (HTML5 / WebRTC).

name: Event Notifications (Alerting)
description: Sends notifications to Telegram, Discord, Slack, or Email on events (power loss, overheating, etc.).

name: Multi-User Collaboration
description: Collaborative mode where several admins view the same screen and hand control off to one another.

name: Open Source Firmware & Plugins
description: Open firmware source code, with support for installing third-party community modules/plugins.

name: REST API / Webhooks
description: An open API for controlling the KVM via scripts (Python, Ansible, Terraform).

name: Scripting
description: Support for scripting and automation (API, macros).

name: Serial Console Web Gateway
description: Opens and controls the serial console port directly through the web interface or SSH.

name: Software Ecosystem & Client
description: An ecosystem of applications and dedicated clients for access.

name: Software USB Replug
description: Software-simulated USB cable disconnect/reconnect (to reset devices that got stuck).

name: System Health & Fan Control
description: Software monitoring of system health and temperatures, plus control over cooling profiles.

name: 2FA / TOTP Support
description: Supports two-factor authentication when logging into the KVM.

name: Audit Trail / Event Logging
description: A detailed activity log for the system (login events, ATX commands, image mounts).

name: Encrypted Stream (TLS 1.3 / AES-256)
description: Software-level encryption of the video stream and input commands.

name: Enterprise Auth (LDAP / AD / SSO)
description: Ability to integrate with corporate user directories.

name: No Subscription (On-Premise Only)
description: All features are guaranteed to work without paid subscriptions, cloud lock-in, or third-party servers.

name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
description: Permission segregation (e.g. view-only, full access, ATX-only access).

name: Session Recording
description: Automatically records the admin session's video stream for later security audits.

name: AI Agents
description: Integration with AI agents for task automation and host management.

name: BIOS-in-Terminal (OCR)
description: Ability to work in the BIOS via a terminal, using OCR for text recognition.

name: Fleet Management / Central Dashboard
description: Support for consolidating multiple KVMs into a single management dashboard (data centers, device fleets).

name: Immutable Snapshots
description: Support for immutable state snapshots for safe rollback.

name: IPMI / Redfish Emulation
description: The KVM's ability to present itself as a standard server IPMI/iDRAC interface, for integration with monitoring systems.

name: Mass Deployment / Auto-Provisioning
description: Ability to quickly configure dozens of KVMs via configuration files (cloud-init / Ansible).

name: Privacy / Blank Screen Mode
description: Ability to programmatically turn off the physical monitor on the target PC during a session.

name: OTA Updates
description: Over-the-air (wireless) firmware/software updates.
